title: New coumarin–chalcone–triazole hybrids as promising anti-diabetic agents: from molecular design to in vivo validation
content:

Fariba Peytam, Maryam Norouzbahari, Mahsa Akbari, Hayrettin Ozan Gülcan, Mahfam Moradi, Somayeh Mojtabavi, Mohammad Ali Faramarzi, Fahimeh Ghasemi, Mohammadreza Torabi, Maliheh Barazandeh Tehrani, Vahid Sheibani, Loghman Firoozpour, Alireza Foroumadi
Novel coumarin–chalcone–triazole hybrids were designed and synthesized as potent α-glucosidase inhibitors. Lead compound 20q showed exceptional enzymatic potency, strong selectivity, and remarkable in vivo antihyperglycemic activity.
